hypothesis: Invalidate a cached completion if the shared sequential cohort is reopened, so workers recheck its original tasks instead of idling forever.

reproduction.scope: CPU fixture, no remote GPU observation
reproduction.reason: Worker retained terminal=complete after a different worker restored an earlier shared phase; stopped only by fixture watchdog.

observations: Reopened cohort finishes by adopting old completed outputs, with no duplicate task execution.
A reopened cohort with a permanent failure exits instead of waiting or starting later cohorts.
A live lease keeps later cohorts queued, and a stop request returns75.
Existing lifetime retry caps and checkpoint sentinels remain intact.

scientific_measurements.note: CPU scheduler tests are not scientific learning results.
